name: computer-use
description: Operating knowledge for Claude Code's built-in computer-use MCP server (desktop screen control). /computer-use:diagnose resolves a symptom to a cause instead of retrying: the fixed screenshot pixel budget and why zoom recovers detail, how to read capture and input failures, and per-OS quirks that make synthesized keys or menus behave unlike a human's. /computer-use:setup verifies prerequisites and reports environment settings that end a session mid-run.
